items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, public beta, public data display, alert expansion, affiliate or advertising expansion, and external outreach. Conditional only for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Exact decision: keep the gated product private, retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked, keep outreach unsent, and continue evidence-only work. Evidence: upstream API access is documented, but rights to store, derive, display, cache, alert on, or monetize returned data are not established; all four legal launch tasks remain open; security, accuracy, freshness, attribution, measurement, and owner gates are incomplete. Technical compliance is a baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown. Human counsel is required for upstream rights and jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment. This is risk triage, not legal advice or certification.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed; all remain open: searchwoot-legal-source-rights, searchwoot-data-flow-retention, searchwoot-ga4-consent-evidence, and searchwoot-logs-vendors-incident. No task is closable on current evidence. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required; user alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed. No monetization expansion, public display, alert expansion, or external sharing is approved.

Private-site decision: retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked. Both are scaffolds with analytics unconfigured and unreachable compliance evidence; public launch or monetization is unsupported. Next evidence action for each is a timestamped checklist covering reachability, content, disclosures, consent/cookies, privacy, terms, analytics, monetization, claims, provenance, copyright/trademark, platform policy, and age-sensitive concerns, followed by exactly one disposition: retain parked or bounded launch.
